about.heading: We are Clint and Marina - hi!
about.paragraph1: From our desire to creatively “wineify” all kinds of get-togethers, Dineysos was born: an innovative and unique provider of wine game concepts that will turn your event into the new hot topic in an unconventional way.
about.paragraph2: Our story begins like many others: After the third bottle of wine, we came to the realisation that a majority of events these days are very generic and the people have been waiting for something new. By combining a little pastime with the aforementioned wine, a solution was quickly found: Dineysos!
about.paragraph3: Our concepts are educational, fun as well as flexibly adaptable and can be perfectly integrated into afterworks, employee events, dinner parties and any other kind of happening.
about.paragraph4: Everything is possible, from a simple “we bring our games and a suitcase full of wine” to a complete event with a suitable location and culinary delights.
about.marina: A hobby artist with a flair for Excel-spreadsheets and a passion for all-things food.
about.clint: A brunch enthusiast, who never leaves the house without a hat and has an undeniable passion for wine - lots of wine.

concept.heading: Concepts
concept.description: Our concepts are always straightforward and educational in a fun way. They combine a playful component with a focus on wine theory. Social interaction and an accessible introduction are always at the heart of the experience. The level and the wines can be flexibly adapted to your needs.

format.title: Formats
format.description1: Each Dineysos concept only comes to life through your event, the possibilities and combinations are endless. The rustic gastronomer around the corner interested in embarking on a wine & dine adventure will receive just as suitable a suggestion from us as the fancy tech company organising its 500 person employee event or the individual planning a dinner party at home.
format.description2: Our goal is to make every event unique, but we would like to share our recommendations for concept-format combinations:

pricing.title: Prices
pricing.description: The following guide prices can be used to roughly estimate the cost of an event. The pricing depends on many factors (choice of wine, possible external venue, food, etc.). We are happy to provide you with an individual offer upon request or after a meeting:

table.basePriceDescription: incl. dossiers, hosting, game concepts (ca. 2 hours)
table.winePairingDescription: essential for the execution of the event
table.foodDescription: Service of courses extends the duration of the event
table.extensionDescription: Due to food or client’s wish

audience.question: Who are the concepts suitable for?
audience.answer: For companies that see team events as an experience, as well as young and young-at-heart individuals looking for games, wine and fun.

duration.question: How long does an event last?
duration.answer: Depending on the event, approximately 1–2 hours. It takes correspondingly longer when combined with a Wine&Dine.

location.question: Where do our events take place?
location.answer: Directly at your location or at one of our partner venues.

included.question: What is included in the price?
included.answer: As a rule, five wines (1 dl of each wine per person), game materials, facilitation by 1–2 hosts and a small prize for the winner are included. Travel expenses are quoted separately.

customization.question: Can the concepts be customized?
customization.answer: Of course. We design your event according to your wishes: The number of wines, their price range and the focus on more education or entertainment can all be adapted flexibly.

sip&solve.description: Experience an exciting tasting puzzle game with your friends and family. Whether in collaborative or competitive spirit, our Sip&Solve Box turns shared enjoyment into an adventure! It will provide you with plenty of conversation starters,  playfully lead you to your wine personalities and bring the typical Dineysos charm into your home.
sip&solve.short: In short: one box, six wines, one game – and lots of ‘aha’ moments, laughter and new picks for your wine cellar!
